bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
file="$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test -f "$file" && test ! -L "$file" || exit 62
git -C "$root" diff --quiet -- scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py || exit 63
backup="$HOME/.local/state/link-pr62-userbot/actual-before.py"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$backup")"
if test -e "$backup"; then cmp -s "$backup" "$file" || exit 64
else cp -p "$file" "$backup"; fi
python3 -B - "$file" <<'PY'
import ast,os,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
path=Path(sys.argv[1])
s=path.read_text(encoding="utf8")
if '"link_button_smoke"' not in s:
    marker='"profile_button_smoke",'
    if s.count(marker)!=1: raise SystemExit(65)
    s=s.replace(marker,marker+' "link_button_smoke",',1)
    anchor='            if action == "profile_button_smoke":'
    if s.count(anchor)!=1: raise SystemExit(66)
    addon='''            if action == "link_button_smoke":
                from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
                if labels != EXPECTED_MENU:
                    raise RuntimeError("LINK_MENU_LAYOUT_INVALID")
                clicked_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
                await latest.click(text="🔗ボタン作成")
                for _ in range(12):
                    recent = await client.get_messages(bot, limit=80)
                    for screen in recent:
                        if screen.out or "🔗ボタンを作成する上で一緒に投稿" not in (screen.raw_text or ""):
                            continue
                        t = screen.edit_date or screen.date
                        if t and t >= clicked_at - timedelta(seconds=2):
                            return {"request_id": request_id, "action": action,
                                    "status": "PASS", "link_editor_opened": True}
                    await asyncio.sleep(1)
                raise RuntimeError("LINK_BUTTON_SCREEN_NOT_OPENED")
'''
    s=s.replace(anchor,addon+anchor,1)
ast.parse(s)
mode=path.stat().st_mode & 0o777
fd,temp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".link-verify-",dir=path.parent)
try:
    os.fchmod(fd,mode)
    with os.fdopen(fd,"w",encoding="utf8") as f: f.write(s)
    os.replace(temp,path)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(temp):os.unlink(temp)
PY
restore(){
 cp -p "$backup" "$file"
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap restore ERR
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 4
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 67
(cd "$root/scripts" && python3 -B userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null) || exit 68
(cd "$root/scripts" && python3 -B userbot_test_client.py link_button_smoke >/dev/null) || exit 69
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
trap - ERR
echo USERBOT_LINK_DM_BUTTON_E2E=PASS
echo USERBOT_AUTH_SESSION_KEPT=PASS
echo ONLY_LINK_TEST_ADAPTER_CHANGED=PASS
